card.name: Descriptive words in infection descriptions
card.fires_on: Small descriptive or linking words (adjectives, 'with', 'form', commas) inside sentences describing infections, lesions or symptoms. They sit just before a symptom or microbe term.

modes.label: Adjectives before lesion terms
modes.description: Size or appearance adjectives that come before blisters, nodules or rods.
modes.example: HSV Type 1 infections are tiny,<< clear>>, fluid filled blisters most often seen

modes.label: Linking words before symptoms
modes.description: Small linking words or verbs that lead into a symptom or finding.
modes.example: He was admitted because of a productive cough<< with>> hemoptysis for 17 weeks

modes.label: Non-medical science text
modes.description: The same kind of word appears in microbiology or geology descriptions.
modes.example: result in<< growth>> of new mineral assemblages

card.writes: It seems to push toward disease-related and descriptive continuations such as 'disease', with weak and mixed effects otherwise.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting or describing words in passages about infections, right before the symptom or germ is named.
